DEFINE sql:select-option "order"
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>

request: Can you give me the number of patients with a billed diagnosis of Verätzung Grad 2a der Schulter und des Armes, ausgenommen Handgelenk und Hand: Achselhöhle per 10-year age cohort?
sparql:
DEFINE sql:select-option "order"
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX sphn-individual: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn/individual#>

  GRAPH ?g {
    ?dx rdf:type sphn:BilledDiagnosis .
    ?dx sphn:hasCode ?dx_code .
    ?dx_code rdf:type icd-10-gm:T22.63 OPTION(inference "https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/global") .

DEFINE sql:select-option "order"
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX sphn-individual: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn/individual#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
PREFIX chop: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/chop/>
PREFIX snomed: <http://snomed.info/id/>
PREFIX loinc: <https://loinc.org/rdf/>
PREFIX ucum: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/ucum/>
PREFIX bif: <bif:>
SELECT ?decade (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?patients)
WHERE {
  GRAPH ?g {
    ?onco rdf:type sphn:OncologyDiagnosis .
    ?onco sphn:hasCode ?onco_code .
    ?onco_code rdf:type icd-10-gm:H11.3 OPTION(inference "https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/global") .
    ?onco sphn:hasSubjectAge ?age .
    ?age sphn:hasQuantity ?age_q .
    ?age_q sphn:hasValue ?age_value .
  }
  BIND(FLOOR(?age_value / 10) * 10 AS ?decade)
}
GROUP BY ?decade
ORDER BY ?decade
request_template_version: For my study, please at what ages do patients get an oncology diagnosis of Blutung der Konjunktiva? Group by decade.
template: At what ages do patients get {S0}? Group by decade.
fills: an oncology diagnosis of Blutung der Konjunktiva

DEFINE sql:select-option "order"
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX sphn-individual: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn/individual#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
PREFIX chop: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/chop/>
PREFIX snomed: <http://snomed.info/id/>
PREFIX loinc: <https://loinc.org/rdf/>
PREFIX ucum: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/ucum/>
PREFIX bif: <bif:>
SELECT ?year (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?patients)
WHERE {
  GRAPH ?g {
    ?sample rdf:type sphn:Sample .
    ?sample sphn:hasMaterialTypeCode ?sample_code .
    ?sample_code rdf:type snomed:369613006 OPTION(inference "https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/global") .
    ?sample sphn:hasCollectionDateTime ?sample_date .
  }
  BIND(YEAR(?sample_date) AS ?year)
}
GROUP BY ?year
ORDER BY ?year
request_template_version: How has the number of patients with a sample of type 'Tissue specimen obtained for Hodgkin's disease by biopsy' changed over the years?
template: How has the number of patients with {S0} changed over the years?
fills: a sample of type 'Tissue specimen obtained for Hodgkin's disease by biopsy'

DEFINE sql:select-option "order"
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX sphn-individual: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn/individual#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX icd-10-gm: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/icd-10-gm/>
PREFIX chop: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/chop/>
PREFIX snomed: <http://snomed.info/id/>
PREFIX loinc: <https://loinc.org/rdf/>
PREFIX ucum: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/ucum/>
PREFIX bif: <bif:>
SELECT ?sex (MIN(?value) AS ?minimum_value) (COUNT((DISTINCT ?g) AS ?patients)
WHERE {
  GRAPH ?g {
    ?m rdf:type sphn:BodySurfaceArea .
    ?m sphn:hasQuantity ?quantity .
    ?quantity sphn:hasValue ?value .
    ?admin_sex rdf:type sphn:AdministrativeSex .
    ?admin_sex sphn:hasCode ?sex_code .
    ?sex_code rdf:type ?sex .
  }
}
GROUP BY ?sex
request_template_version: Give me the minimum body surface area by administrative sex, with patient counts.
template: Give me the minimum {S0} by administrative sex, with patient counts.
fills: body surface area

PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>

PREFIX ucum: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/ucum/>

DEFINE sql:select-option "order"
PREFIX sphn: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn#>
PREFIX sphn-individual: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-schema/sphn/individual#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

PREFIX chop: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/chop/>
PREFIX snomed: <http://snomed.info/id/>
PREFIX loinc: <https://loinc.org/rdf/>
PREFIX ucum: <https://biomedit.ch/rdf/sphn-resource/ucum/>
PREFIX bif: <bif:>
SELECT ?sex (MAX(?value) AS ?maximum_value) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?patients)
WHERE {
  GRAPH ?g {
    ?m rdf:type sphn:InhaledOxygenConcentration .
    ?m sphn:hasQuantity ?quantity .
    ?quantity sphn:hasValue ?value .
    ?admin_sex rdf:type sphn:AdministrativeSex .
    ?admin_sex sphn:hasCode ?sex_code .
    ?sex_code rdf:type ?sex .
  }
}
GROUP BY ?sex
template: What is the maximum {S0} per sex?
fills: inhaled oxygen concentration
